text: How many days do I have to dispute something on my credit card? The store never credited the blender I returned.
I filed a dispute on my credit card two weeks ago for $214. Do I have to pay interest on that amount while you look into it?
An online shop charged my Fernhollow credit card twice for the same order of $58.40. The shop does not answer my emails. Can I dispute the second charge?
I paid for concert tickets with my debit card and the concert was cancelled. The seller will not refund me. What do I do?
What is the deadline to dispute a debit card purchase? It is on last month's statement.
What proof should I upload for my dispute about a sofa that never arrived?
You asked me for documents for my dispute while I was traveling, and now the dispute shows as closed. Can I still send them?
The temporary credit for my card dispute disappeared from my account today. Why would that happen?
Your questions page says I have 60 days to dispute a credit card charge, but the app says 120 days. Which one is right?
label_note: Conflict: the old Q&A article KB03-1 (last reviewed 2023) says 60 days; the current article KB01-2 says 120 days. The current article wins.

text: Can I just email you my card number and the receipts to start a dispute?
label_note: KB01-2 lists the app and Card Services as channels. KB03-2 (an older Q&A, still current) says card disputes cannot be filed by email. KB35-2 warns against sending card numbers.

text: how long does a credit card dispute usually take
Three months ago I bought a used laptop online with my debit card. It stopped working and the seller has disappeared. Am I too late to dispute the purchase?
I want to dispute a charge on my business credit card for my bakery. Is the process different for business cards?
label_note: The help center covers personal cards only. The card dispute process (KB01-1, KB01-2) gives general context, not the business-card answer.

text: The merchant won my dispute and you took the credit back. I do not agree with the decision. Can I appeal it?
label_note: KB01-3 says the decision is explained in writing; no passage describes an appeal.

text: Do I have to contact the merchant before I dispute a debit card purchase?
Should I mail you the original receipt for my dispute or a copy?
A hotel charged my credit card a $95 no-show fee even though I cancelled on time. I have the cancellation number. Is this something I can dispute, and what happens next?
label_note: KB01-1 covers wrong charges, KB04-1 lists cancellation numbers as proof, and KB01-3 says what happens after filing.

text: someone is using my debit card right now, I just got 3 alerts for purchases in another state. help
Am I responsible for fraud charges on my credit card if I only noticed them on my statement from two months ago?
label_note: The 60-day window (KB05-2) runs from a statement two months old, so the deadline is days away.

text: I reported fraud on my checking account 6 business days ago and I still have no decision. How long does this take?
You removed the temporary credit from my fraud claim and nobody told me why. Is that allowed?

How long until my new card arrives after a fraud report?
While you review my identity theft claim, will the account someone opened in my name hurt my credit?

Do I need to sign anything for my fraud claim?
My elderly mother was talked into buying gift cards for a caller and she read him the numbers an hour ago. Can you stop the gift cards?
label_note: Scam payments are covered in KB07; nothing covers stopping gift cards.

text: Is the fraud line open on Sunday night?
My wallet was stolen with my Fernhollow debit card in it. I locked the card. Do you also offer identity theft insurance?
label_note: Locking and replacement are covered; insurance is not. The card is already locked, so the message is routine.

text: There is a charge on my credit card from a store I have never heard of. Should I dispute it?
label_note: The customer asks whether to dispute a charge they do not recognize, so the topic is disputes. KB01-1 sends it to fraud reporting (KB05-1).

text: There is a Fernhollow account on my credit report that I do not recognize. I never opened it.
label_note: Could also be routed to credit reporting; the account was opened by someone else, so it is identity theft.

text: Will I get a temporary credit while you investigate the unauthorized withdrawal from my savings?
Can you add a travel notice to my card so it is not blocked in Portugal next month?
label_note: No passage covers travel notices.

text: I sent $150 with QuickSend to the wrong phone number five minutes ago. Can you cancel it?
label_note: KB08-2 covers enrolled recipients; it does not say what happens if the wrong number is not enrolled (general context only).

text: What is the most I can send with QuickSend in one day?
How fast does a QuickSend payment arrive? My sister is already enrolled.
If I send a domestic wire at 4 pm today, will it go out today?
I sent an international wire last Friday and the person has not received it yet. Can you trace it?
label_note: No passage covers tracing a wire.

text: Can I set up a QuickSend payment that repeats every month for my rent?
label_note: No passage covers repeating payments.

text: My QuickSend payment went to an old number that belongs to someone else now. They will not answer. What are my options?
Does QuickSend work with banks in other countries?
label_note: KB08-1 does not say.

text: Where do I find the routing number for a wire into my savings account?
Can I use QuickSend from my savings account?
label_note: KB08-1 says QuickSend sends money from a checking account.

text: I want to send money to my son overseas every month. Which is cheaper, a wire or QuickSend?
label_note: Wire fees are in KB15-1. No passage gives QuickSend fees or says QuickSend can send abroad.

text: I paid a seller with QuickSend and he never shipped the bike. Can I reverse the payment?
label_note: Also a scam case (KB07).

text: I sent a wire to the wrong account number an hour ago. Please get it back!
label_note: No passage covers recalling a wire.

text: My friend is not enrolled in QuickSend yet. Will the money still reach her within minutes?
label_note: KB08-1 gives the speed for enrolled recipients only.

text: If my checking account is short by $40 tonight, what will the overdraft cost me?
I was charged $35 for an overdraft in February 2026. Was that the right amount?
label_note: The archived fee schedule KB11 applied until March 31, 2026, so $35 was correct then.

text: I was overdrawn by $6 at the end of the day yesterday and you charged me an overdraft fee. Is that right?
label_note: No fee at $10 or less (KB10-1), so the fee was charged in error (KB13-2).

text: Can you waive the overdraft fee from Tuesday? It is my first one this year.

How do I avoid the $5 fee on my savings account?

What interest rate does Basic Savings pay?
label_note: Account terms, not a fee: routed to account services (the topic was corrected after the split was drawn).

text: Do I have to pay for a new debit card if mine was stolen?
How long does a fee refund take to show up in my account?
When does interest start on a cash advance, and how much is the cash advance fee?
label_note: Interest timing is in KB14-2; no passage gives a cash advance fee.

text: Do you charge me when someone wires money into my account?

Why was I charged $2 on my statement for a paper statement?
I got two overdraft fees in one week and money is really tight right now. Is there anything you can do?
label_note: Courtesy refunds are limited to one per 12 months (KB13-1); a second one is reviewed case by case.

How do I close my savings account? I moved to another state.

Why is my $7,000 check on hold for a whole week?
Someone texted me saying they are from Fernhollow and asked for the code you just sent me. Is that real?
label_note: A fraud attempt; the answer is in the security-code article.

text: I got a security code by text that I did not ask for. Should I worry?
Can I open a checking account for my 15-year-old son?
label_note: No passage covers accounts for minors.

label_note: KB17-2: 3 to 10 business days after documents arrive, so this review is longer than usual.

Should I dispute a wrong item with you or with the credit bureau?

label_note: KB22-2 promises 30 days; no passage says what to do after that, so a complaint (KB34-1) is the closest step.
